# Portability audit
<!-- Generated by system/kit/adapter_indexes.py at build time from the files that ship. Do not edit. -->

1217 files. Counts: 889 portable, 156 adapter, 96 amp-only, 76 cmux-only.

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `portable` | Runs or reads the same in any harness: plain Python and shell, Markdown, templates, configs. |
| `adapter` | Policy or docs that mention Amp or cmux; the harness adapter (CLAUDE.md import, Codex AGENTS.md, Cursor rule, SYSTEM.md) supplies the equivalent and nothing else is needed. |
| `amp-only` | Depends on the Amp plugin API, amp-mem or the amp CLI. Optional outside Amp; the Claude Code hook in `.claude/hooks/` covers the shell-expressible guardrails. |
| `cmux-only` | Drives cmux or wmux workspaces and tabs. Optional everywhere else; dispatch degrades to running tasks in your own terminal. |
